about: What a .docx written by particle-academy/last-word cannot express. Each entry quotes the last-word document that states it; tests/LimitsCatalogTest.php fails when a quote is no longer in the installed last-word, so a limit last-word lifts, or rewords, cannot linger here unnoticed. The statement and alternatives are what the person is told, so they are plain words.

limits.statement: A Word page has one pair of side margins, shared by the header, the body and the footer, so the header cannot have different side margins from the body.
limits.appliesWhen: The request asks for the header or footer to use different left or right margins from the body: no margins for the header only, header art edge to edge while the body keeps its margins, a wider footer.
alternatives: Set the side margins to zero for the whole page, so the header art runs edge to edge and the body text does too.
Keep the header art inside the page margins, as it is now.

sources.quote: `page.margins` takes `top`, `right`, `bottom`, `left` and the header and footer **distances**, `header` / `footer`: points from the top edge of the page to the header and from the bottom edge to the footer
Page margins in points, 72 (one inch) each side by default, and the header and footer DISTANCES: how far the header sits from the top edge of the page and the footer from the bottom edge

limits.statement: A picture or other block always sits inside the page margins; it cannot run past them to the edge of the page.
limits.appliesWhen: The request asks for a picture, band or block to bleed off the page, run to the page edge, or sit partly in the margin, while the margins stay.
alternatives: Set the page margins to zero, so the picture can reach the edge of the page.
Keep the picture inside the margins at the full width of the text.
limits.council: Fancy CC-fancy-0055 (pending): whether last-word should offer a bleed. Until it lands, the documented behaviour below is the limit.

sources.quote: the writer sniffs intrinsic size straight from the PNG IHDR / JPEG SOF bytes and caps at 6.5in page width keeping aspect.
Width in px at 96 dpi; capped at the text column.

limits.statement: A header or footer cannot hold a chart or a page break.
limits.appliesWhen: The request asks for a chart, or a page break, inside the header or footer.
alternatives: Put the chart in the body, at the top of the first page.
Put the figure in the header as a picture instead of a chart.

sources.section: Headers and footers: a band, or blocks
sources.quote: A blocks header takes every block type except `chart` and `pageBreak`, at any depth

limits.statement: A header or footer cannot hold a footnote, and a footnote cannot hold another footnote.
limits.appliesWhen: The request asks for a footnote in the header or footer, or a footnote on a footnote.
alternatives: Put the note in the body text, as a footnote on the first page.
Write the note into the header or footer as plain small text.

sources.quote: but not inside another footnote and not in a header or footer

limits.statement: A Word document has one page colour for every page; one part of it cannot have a different background.
limits.appliesWhen: The request asks for a different page background on some pages or after a page break.
alternatives: Use one page colour for the whole document.
Shade the paragraphs or table on those pages instead of the page.

sources.quote: `page.background` on a break is refused: Word has one page colour per document.

limits.statement: Pictures must be PNG or JPEG; other formats such as SVG, GIF or EMF cannot be placed.
limits.appliesWhen: The request asks to place a picture that is not PNG or JPEG.
alternatives: Convert the picture to PNG and place that.

sources.section: Headers and footers: a band, or blocks (Hardening)
sources.quote: A header or footer image, whether an agent wrote it or `read()` took it from an upload, must be PNG or JPEG by its leading bytes as well as its type
